title: Pet Groomers in Miami, FL | Lovely Pets Grooming Salon

facts.fact: Lovely Pets Grooming Salon says it is a family-owned business that has served Miami since 1999.
facts.quote: We are a family-owned business that has served Miami since 1999.

facts.fact: The salon's page displays a 4.8-star rating from 336 Google reviews.
The salon's stated hours are Tuesday to Saturday, 8 AM to 5 PM.
facts.quote: Tue–Sat 8 AM–5 PM · Walk-ins welcome before 2 PM

facts.fact: The salon says walk-ins are welcome Tuesday to Saturday before 2:00 PM, and after 2 PM it tries to fit dogs in depending on how busy the day is.
facts.quote: Walk-ins are welcome Tuesday to Saturday before 2:00 PM.

facts.fact: The salon states a full groom starts at $85 for small and medium dogs.
facts.quote: A full groom starts at $85 for small and medium dogs

facts.fact: The salon states a full groom goes up to $185 for giant breeds.
facts.quote: goes up to $185 for giant breeds.

facts.fact: The salon says its final grooming price depends on the dog's size, coat condition and behavior.
facts.quote: The final price depends on your dog's size, coat condition and behavior.

facts.fact: The salon says it picks up and drops off dogs at home Thursday through Saturday across most of Miami.
facts.quote: We pick up and drop off dogs at home Thursday through Saturday

facts.fact: The salon says home pickup pricing depends on distance and breed.
facts.quote: Pricing depends on distance and breed, so call us to confirm your area.

facts.fact: The salon says it offers weekly packages for regular pickup-and-delivery clients.
The salon says it has run a cage-free dog hotel since 2009.
facts.quote: We have run a cage-free dog hotel since 2009.

facts.fact: The salon says Tuesdays and Wednesdays are its Senior Dog Days.
facts.quote: Tuesdays and Wednesdays are our Senior Dog Days

facts.fact: For senior dog days, the salon says it calls owners 20 minutes before pickup.
The salon says nail trims done with a Dremel or file are walk-in service Tuesday to Saturday before 2:00 PM with no appointment needed.
facts.quote: Nail trims with Dremel or file are walk-in, Tuesday to Saturday before 2:00 PM, no appointment needed.

facts.fact: The salon says it will not add extra charges without explanation; for extra treatments it explains them before starting or calls to get approval first.
facts.quote: we explain it before we start, or we call you to approve it first.

facts.fact: The salon says its styling stations and equipment are disinfected between every grooming.
facts.quote: Styling stations and equipment are disinfected between every grooming.

facts.fact: The salon says it states that holiday closures and special hours are posted on its Google Business Profile and social media.
facts.quote: Holiday closures and special hours are posted on our Google Business Profile and social media
